title: Independent Generalization / External Validation
decision_rationale: No credible, adequately-covered independent dataset could be obtained.

Only independent clinically-sourced candidate (Columbia University Disease-Symptom KB) is license-pending (Phase 7G manual-review requirement) and aggregated association-count format, not case/patient-level.
Label coverage: 8 EXACT / 8 HIGH_CONFIDENCE / 3 POSSIBLE / 22 NO_MATCH of 41; automatic use limited to 8 EXACT per mapping rules.
Feature coverage: 14 EXACT + 10 HIGH_CONFIDENCE of 397 unique Columbia symptoms (6.05%); per-disease retained evidence 0-57% (1 disease 0%, 4 <=30%).
Large public disease-symptom datasets mirror the SymbiPredict canonical family (leakage risk) or are artificially generated (246k-row Mendeley set, DDXPlus synthetic).
Real patient datasets (Brazil SINAN, HCMC dengue cohort) are single-disease (Dengue); MIMIC-III lacks a symptom-presence matrix.
No clinician review available for HIGH_CONFIDENCE/POSSIBLE mappings; evaluation would be a mapping-coverage artifact, not generalization evidence.
generalization_claim: NOT_TESTED - Phase 7I ceiling performance could not be assessed against independent observations; no evidence for or against external generalization was produced.

phase7i_vs_phase7k.comparison_fallback: NO EXTERNAL METRICS EXIST - direct comparison not possible and not attempted.
phase7i_vs_phase7k.why_not_comparable: Phase 7I used grouped CV on canonical SymbiPredict associations; Phase 7K found no valid independent evaluation set.

leakage_check.detail: No copies or canonical-signature replication detected across sources; mean symptom-set Jaccard 0.022 for shared EXACT-label diseases (Columbia vs Phase 7I).

disclaimer: Non-clinical research/educational evaluation; not clinically validated; does not establish medical diagnostic accuracy, clinical validity, or suitability for patient care.
phase7j: NOT READY - external generalization unverified; integration/deployment prohibited without explicit approval.
